class YOLO_adapter.C2f_Adapter(c1: int, c2: int, n: int = 1, shortcut: bool = False, g: int = 1, e: float = 0.5, r: float = 0.25)[source]

Bases: C2f

Drop-in replacement for C2f that adds a parallel YOLOAdapterBlock whose output is summed element-wise with the original C2f output.

The expansion ratio r is assigned dynamically by AdapterManager based on the parameter count of the original C2f block:

  • Heavy (N_p > 5M): r = 1.0

  • Medium (1M < N_p ≤ 5M): r = 0.5

  • Light (N_p ≤ 1M): r = 0.25

Parameters:

  • c1 (int) – Number of input channels.

  • c2 (int) – Number of output channels.

  • n (int) – Number of bottleneck repetitions.

  • shortcut (bool) – Whether to use residual shortcuts in bottleneck blocks.

  • g (int) – Number of groups for grouped convolution.

  • e (float) – Channel expansion ratio for the hidden dimension inside C2f.

  • r (float) – Channel expansion ratio for the adapter hidden dimension.

forward(x)[source]

Run the C2f forward pass and add the adapter output element-wise.

Parameters:

x (torch.Tensor) – Input feature map of shape (B, C_in, H, W).

Returns:

Sum of the C2f output and the adapter output, both of shape (B, C_out, H, W).

class YOLO_adapter.YOLOAdapterBlock(c1: int, c2: int, r: float = 0.25, k: int = 3, s: int = 2, p: int = 1)[source]

Bases: Module

Lightweight bottleneck adapter inserted in parallel with a C2f block.

Performs a spatial downsampling via Conv2d followed by an upsampling via ConvTranspose2d, forcing the adapter to learn a compressed representation before being added element-wise to the C2f output.

Parameters:

  • c1 (int) – Number of input channels.

  • c2 (int) – Number of output channels.

  • r (float) – Channel expansion ratio used to compute the hidden dimension as max(1, int(c1 * r)). Assigned dynamically based on the parameter count of the parallel C2f block.

  • k (int) – Kernel size for both convolutional layers.

  • s (int) – Stride for both convolutional layers.

  • p (int) – Padding for both convolutional layers.

forward(x)[source]

Run the adapter forward pass.

Downsamples the input spatially, applies ReLU, then upsamples back to the original spatial dimensions using output_size to handle inputs with odd spatial dimensions.

Parameters:

x (torch.Tensor) – Input feature map of shape (B, C_in, H, W).

Returns:

Output feature map of shape (B, C_out, H, W).

Return type:

torch.Tensor

class adapter_manager.AdapterManager(pt_path: str)[source]

Bases: object

Manages the full lifecycle of YOLO-Adapter model construction and weight loading.

Handles C2f block replacement, layer freezing, data-driven weight initialization, and checkpoint loading. Designed to be model-size agnostic: the expansion ratio r is assigned automatically based on each C2f block’s parameter count.

Parameters:

pt_path (str) – Path to the base YOLOv8 .pt checkpoint.

Expansion ratio thresholds

  • N_p > 5M → r = 1.0 (Heavy)

  • 1M < N_p ≤ 5M → r = 0.5 (Medium)

  • N_p ≤ 1M → r = 0.25 (Light)

HEAVY_THRESHOLD = 5000000
MEDIUM_THRESHOLD = 1000000
build(nc: int = None) → YOLO[source]

Build the adapted model from the base checkpoint.

Replaces all C2f blocks with C2f_Adapter, copies the original C2f weights, freezes the backbone, and prints a parameter summary.

Parameters:

nc (int, optional) – Number of output classes. If None, keeps the original checkpoint value (80 for COCO). When provided, the detection head is reinitialised with the new class count.

Returns:

The adapted YOLO model ready for training.

Return type:

YOLO

init_adapters_from_data(dataloader, device: str = 'cpu')[source]

Run data-driven adapter weight initialization.

Performs a single forward pass over the full dataloader to compute the variance ratio λ for each C2f_Adapter block, then reinitialises the adapter weights with N(0, 2λ / (n_in + n_out)). Must be called after build().

Parameters:

  • dataloader – DataLoader yielding batches with an 'img' key containing uint8 tensors of shape (B, 3, H, W).

  • device (str) – Torch device string, e.g. 'cpu' or 'cuda:0'.

Raises:

AssertionError – If build() has not been called first.

load_trained(weights_path: str, nc: int = None) → YOLO[source]

Rebuild the adapted architecture and load fine-tuned weights.

Useful for inference: rebuilds the custom architecture (required since Ultralytics cannot deserialize C2f_Adapter from a plain checkpoint without the custom architecture being present) and then loads the trained state dict.

Parameters:

  • weights_path (str) – Path to the fine-tuned .pt checkpoint produced by CustomTrainer.

  • nc (int, optional) – Number of output classes. Must match the value used during training. If None, keeps the original checkpoint value (80).

Returns:

The adapted YOLO model with trained weights loaded.

Return type:

YOLO

class custom_trainer.CustomTrainer(adapted_model, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: DetectionTrainer

Custom Ultralytics trainer that preserves adapter-only training.

Subclasses DetectionTrainer to:

  • Inject the pre-built adapted model, bypassing Ultralytics model reconstruction from YAML.

  • Re-apply parameter freezing after the parent _setup_train unfreezes all layers.

  • Run data-driven λ initialization using the training dataloader.

  • Rebuild the optimizer’s parameter groups and learning-rate scheduler to include only the trainable adapter parameters.

  • Save checkpoints with the correct adapted architecture instead of the default Ultralytics 80-class serialization.

Parameters:

  • adapted_model (ultralytics.YOLO) – The adapted YOLO model returned by build().

  • kwargs – Keyword arguments forwarded to DetectionTrainer, including the overrides dict with training hyperparameters.

save_model()[source]

Save checkpoints with the correct adapted architecture.

Overrides the default Ultralytics serialization which stores the original 80-class DetectionModel. Instead, saves the full adapted model — including C2f_Adapter blocks and the detection head with the correct number of classes — so that load_trained() can restore it without any class mismatch.

class trainer_manager.TrainerManager(base_pt_dir: str, runs_dir: str, results_dir: str, nc: int, mlflow_uri: str, test_dir: str, imgsz: int = 480)[source]

Bases: object

Orchestrates training and evaluation across datasets and model sizes.

For each dataset a single MLflow experiment is created. Within it, one run per model size logs parameters, metrics and prediction artefacts.

Metrics computed during _test:

  • mAP50 / mAP50-95 — standard COCO detection metrics (global).

  • Per-class breakdown — AP50, AP50-95, Precision, Recall, F1, and Accuracy (TP / (TP + FP + FN)) for every class.

  • Mean IoU — average IoU of all matched (TP) detections.

  • Cell-count MAE — Mean Absolute Error between the number of predicted cells and ground-truth cells per image, computed by running inference over the test split image-by-image.

Parameters:

  • base_pt_dir (str) – Directory containing base YOLO .pt checkpoints.

  • runs_dir (str) – Root directory for Ultralytics run outputs.

  • results_dir (str) – Root directory where prediction images are saved.

  • nc (int) – Number of output classes.

  • mlflow_uri (str) – MLflow tracking URI.

  • test_dir (str) – Path to the test image directory.

  • imgsz (int) – Input image size (shorter side). Default: 480.

class handler.YOLOAdapterHandler[source]

Bases: BaseHandler

TorchServe handler for the YOLO C2f-Adapter detection model.

Applies binarization preprocessing before inference to match the training data distribution of the best performing model.

Expected input:

{"image": "<base64_encoded_image>"}

Response:

{
    "detections": [
        {
            "class_id":   2,
            "class_name": "RBC",
            "confidence": 0.91,
            "bbox": {"x1": 120, "y1": 45, "x2": 210, "y2": 98}
        }
    ]
}
